title: Quantitative Diffusive Limits for Singular Nonlocal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.11837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the nonlocal continuity equation \[ \partial_t\mu_b =\operatorname{div}\!\left( \mu_b\nabla\log\bigl((I-b^2\Delta)^{-1}\mu_b\bigr) \right) \] on a closed connected Riemannian manifold. For smooth strictly positive initial data, we prove that as $b \to 0$, its global solution converges to heat flow $\mu(t)$ at the sharp, uniform-in-time rate \[ \sup_{t\ge0}\|\mu_b(t)-\mu(t)\|_{L^1}\le Cb^2. \] The key estimate is the uniform dissipation of a $b$-weighted higher-order resolvent energy, which yields exponential relaxation despite the absence of a Wasserstein gradient-flow structure.   On the circle, we also analyze the corresponding deterministic $N$-particle dynamics. A weak--strong modulated energy argument gives \[ \mathbb E\!\left[ \sup_{t\ge0}W_1(\mu_b^N(t),\mu_b(t)) \right] \le C(Nb)^{-1/2} \] for iid initialization. Consequently, the choice $b\asymp N^{-1/5}$ approximates heat flow uniformly in time at rate $N^{-2/5}$.

translated_title: 奇异非局部输运的定量扩散极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究了闭连通黎曼流形上的非局部连续性方程 $\partial_t\mu_b = \operatorname{div}\left(\mu_b \nabla \log\big((I-b^2\Delta)^{-1}\mu_b\big)\right)$。对于光滑严格正的初始数据，我们证明当 $b \to 0$ 时，其整体解以精确的、关于时间一致的速率收敛于热流 $\mu(t)$：$\sup_{t\ge0}\|\mu_b(t)-\mu(t)\|_{L^1}\le Cb^2$。关键估计是一个 $b$ 加权的高阶预解能量的一致耗散性，尽管缺乏 Wasserstein 梯度流结构，它仍然给出了指数弛豫。在圆周上，我们还分析了相应的确定性 $N$ 粒子动力学。通过弱-强调制能量方法，对独立同分布初始化得到 $\mathbb{E}\big[\sup_{t\ge0}W_1(\mu_b^N(t),\mu_b(t))\big] \le C(Nb)^{-1/2}$。因此，取 $b\asymp N^{-1/5}$ 时，可以以 $N^{-2/5}$ 的速率在时间上一致地逼近热流。
tldr: 本文证明了奇异非局部输运方程在 $b\to0$ 时以最优的、时间一致的速率 $Cb^2$ 收敛于热流，并在圆周情形下通过弱-强调制能量方法建立了 $N$ 粒子系统的定量传播混沌估计，取 $b\asymp N^{-1/5}$ 时以 $N^{-2/5}$ 的速率一致逼近热流。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that the singular nonlocal transport equation converges to the heat flow at the sharp uniform-in-time rate $Cb^2$ as $b\to0$, and establishes quantitative propagation of chaos for the $N$-particle dynamics on the circle via a weak-strong modulated energy argument, achieving $N^{-2/5}$ uniform approximation of the heat flow with $b\asymp N^{-1/5}$.
